This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
starts with a problem in a game studio. Then it explains how to compare the
specifications. It ends with a **Do it** task (in a simulator, on the lab
computer or on your phone) and one set of questions. The full explanations,
examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary system-requirements specifications compatibility bottleneck graphics-settings video-memory storage-capacity operating-system >}}

## 6.1 What does the game need? System requirements

- A store page lists the **system requirements** of a game.
- **Minimum:** the game runs, but at low settings.
- **Recommended:** the game runs well at normal settings.
- *Neon Drift* for PC: minimum Windows 10 (64-bit), 4 cores at 2.5 GHz,
  8 GB RAM, 2 GB video memory, 20 GB free. Recommended: Windows 11, 6 cores
  at 3.5 GHz, 16 GB RAM, a graphics card with 6 GB, 20 GB free on an SSD.
- Phones: Google Play shows **Requires Android**; the App Store shows
  **Compatibility** (for example "Requires iOS 15.0 or later") and the size.

![The system requirements of Neon Drift for PC.](images/requirements.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Minimum is not "good enough". At the minimum, the game runs at low settings.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find the requirements of a game"}
On your phone, open the store page of a game that you play. **Android:**
**About this game → Requires Android**. **iPhone:** **Information → Size**
and **Compatibility**. Write the OS version it requires and its size.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Requirements"}
Use the requirements of Neon Drift above. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="32 GB|Windows 8.1"}
How much RAM does Neon Drift need at the minimum?
:   8 GB

How much RAM does Neon Drift recommend?
:   16 GB

A PC meets only the minimum. How does the game run?
:   at low settings

Where does Google Play show the Android version that a game needs?
:   Requires Android

Which storage does the recommended column want?
:   20 GB free on an SSD
:::
:::

## 6.2 Does it run here? Comparing line by line

- Compare each line of the requirements with the same line of the spec
  sheet: below minimum, minimum or recommended.
- **The weakest line decides** the level of the whole device.
- **Laptop L1:** Windows 11; 8 cores, 4.4 GHz; 16 GB; GPU inside the
  processor, 2 GB; 120 GB free, SSD. Every line is recommended except
  graphics (minimum). So L1 reaches the **minimum**.
- **Old PC O1:** Windows 10; 4 cores, 3.0 GHz; **4 GB RAM**; graphics card,
  2 GB; 60 GB free, HDD. Memory is below the minimum, so O1 is **below
  minimum**.

![Laptop L1 against the requirements.](images/compare-lines.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A fast processor does not help when the GPU is weak. The device is only as
good as its weakest line.
:::

{{< sim file="sims/spec-check.html" poster="sims/spec-check.png" title="Spec Check: does Neon Drift run here?" height="700" >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Spec Check with the lab computer"}
In **Spec Check**, choose **My lab computer** and enter its values (from
your spec sheet of lecture 4, or Settings → System → About and Task Manager
→ Performance). Write the level of the lab computer and its weakest line.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The weakest line"}
Use the requirements of Neon Drift and the devices above. Choose the right
answer.

::: {.match extra="the processor"}
Which level does Laptop L1 reach?
:   minimum

Which line holds Laptop L1 back?
:   graphics

Which level does Old PC O1 reach?
:   below minimum

Which line holds Old PC O1 back?
:   memory

A laptop has 12 GB of RAM. Which level does its memory line reach?
:   minimum
:::
:::

## 6.3 What holds the game back?

- **Compatibility problem:** the game cannot install or start. The OS is
  too old, or the free storage is too small. More power does not help.
- **Performance problem:** the game runs, but slowly. The weakest part is
  the **bottleneck**.
- What helps: weak **GPU** → lower the resolution, shadows and effects.
  Little **video memory** → lower the textures. Little **RAM** → close
  other apps, lower the textures. **HDD** → slow loading: an SSD helps.
- *Neon Drift Mobile*: minimum Android 10, 4 cores, 4 GB RAM, 4 GB free;
  recommended Android 12, 8 cores, 6 GB RAM.
- Phone P3 (**Android 9**): a compatibility problem. Phone P4 (**4 GB
  RAM**): it runs at lower settings; the RAM is the bottleneck.

![Compatibility problem and performance problem.](images/two-problems.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A fast chip does not fix a compatibility problem. Android 9 cannot install a
game that needs Android 10.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Can your phone run it?"}
Compare the OS version and the free storage of your phone (lecture 4) with
the requirements of your game (section 6.1). Is there a compatibility
problem? If the game runs slowly, which part is the bottleneck, and which
setting would you lower?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Which problem?"}
Choose the right answer. You can use an answer more than once.

::: {.match extra="buy more RAM"}
A phone has Android 9. The game needs Android 10. Which kind of problem is it?
:   a compatibility problem

The game runs, but at 25 fps. Which kind of problem is it?
:   a performance problem

The GPU is the bottleneck. What helps first?
:   lower the resolution and the shadows

The game stutters with high textures. What helps?
:   lower the texture quality

The phone has 3 GB free. The game needs 4 GB. Which kind of problem is it?
:   a compatibility problem
:::
:::

## Game challenge: test devices for Neon Drift {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

*Byte Bay* must choose its test devices. A good test lab has one device for
each level: recommended, minimum and below the minimum.

- **Laptop L1:** Windows 11; 8 cores, 4.4 GHz; 16 GB; GPU inside the
  processor, 2 GB; 120 GB free, SSD.
- **Desktop D1:** Windows 11; 6 cores, 4.0 GHz; 16 GB; graphics card, 8 GB;
  300 GB free, SSD.
- **Old PC O1:** Windows 10 (64-bit); 4 cores, 3.0 GHz; 4 GB; graphics card,
  2 GB; 60 GB free, HDD.

{{< sim file="sims/spec-match.html" poster="sims/spec-match.png" title="Spec Match: test devices for Neon Drift" kind="game" height="720" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Sort the computers"}
Neon Drift for PC: minimum 4 cores at 2.5 GHz, 8 GB RAM, 2 GB video memory;
recommended 6 cores at 3.5 GHz, 16 GB RAM, a graphics card with 6 GB.
Devices L1, D1 and O1 as above. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Laptop L1, it has 8 cores"}
Which computer reaches the recommended level?
:   Desktop D1

Which computer reaches only the minimum?
:   Laptop L1

Which computer is below the minimum?
:   Old PC O1

What would bring Old PC O1 to the minimum?
:   8 GB of RAM or more
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · Three phones (harder)"}
Neon Drift Mobile: minimum Android 10, 4 cores, 4 GB RAM, 4 GB free;
recommended Android 12, 8 cores, 6 GB RAM. P1: Android 14, 8 cores, 8 GB,
40 GB free. P3: Android 9, 8 cores, 6 GB, 30 GB free. P4: Android 13, 8
cores, 4 GB, 25 GB free. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Phone P1|its chip"}
Which phone cannot install the game?
:   Phone P3

Why can Phone P3 not install it?
:   Android 9 is too old

Which phone runs the game at lower settings?
:   Phone P4

What is the bottleneck of Phone P4?
:   its RAM
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- System requirements list a minimum (low settings) and a recommended level (runs well).
- Compare a device line by line; the weakest line decides its level.
- A compatibility problem stops the install: an old OS or too little free storage.
- A performance problem has a bottleneck: the weakest part limits the whole device.
- Lower the setting that loads the bottleneck: resolution for the GPU, textures for video memory.
